title: rumex pulcher subsp. divaricatus
intro: Rumex pulcher subsp. divaricatus, commonly known as curly dock or yellow dock, is a plant species in the buckwheat family, Polygonaceae. It is a perennial herb with edible leaves and roots that have been used in traditional medicine for centuries to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Rumex pulcher subsp. divaricatus include its potential to treat digestive problems, skin conditions, and anemia due to its high iron content. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include anthraquinones, flavonoids, and tannins, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
